This repository is a plugin catalog. Follow `AGENTS.md`. Pin Claude, Codex and Copilot plugins by full commit SHA. Two directory sources are the exception, and each records provenance in `VENDORED.md`: `amiga-decoding` (private upstream, commit recorded there) and `red-team-review` (first-party, published in this repository, no separate upstream pin). Cursor entries for vendored packages are in-repo paths under `plugins/`. Do not edit vendored runtime files in place. `pr-flow` is not vendored: every host pins `Wicked-Sick-Ltd/pr-flow` at `be43fc21936ba2054ef084d0193e75a5770b97de`.

The Next.js + Prisma demo app in this tree is Cloud Agent scaffolding (`docs/demo-app.md`), not plugin source, and its listings UI is not a catalog. It depends on Next.js 15.5.28. Catalog edits still go through the JSON indexes plus `python3 scripts/validate.py`. CI also runs `scripts/test_validate.py` and `scripts/test_dependabot_alerts.py`. The demo app is unenforced there.
